evidence.title: Shadcn Datetime Picker — Flexible Date, Time & Timezone Picker for shadcn/ui

name: Shadcn Datetime Picker
summary: Shadcn registry of three date and time pickers: datetime input, simple time picker and datetime picker.
description: Single-file date and time components served through a shadcn registry: a segmented, keyboard-friendly DateTime Input, a Simple Time Picker dropdown and a full DateTime Picker with timezone support, min/max bounds and month/year jump. Timezone-aware and react-hook-form ready, with no runtime dependency.
contains: timezone support, min/max bounds, month/year jump
segmented keyboard-friendly input with form integration
deps: date-fns, react-day-picker, lucide; shadcn button/popover/scroll-area
